name: Sarup Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Sarup Industries Ltd is a manufacturer of footwear including shoes and shoe uppers.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of leather, tanneries and developing new products with wide range of uppers, soles, tanneries and complete shoes. Company manufactures export quality shoes in Northern India and also a supplier of international brands.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.02% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 28.9% of their holding.
Company has high debtors of 218 days.
